app.name: Microsoft Copilot
app.description: Microsoft Copilot is a personal AI assistant powered by OpenAI and Microsoft AI technology that helps with tasks from work projects to creative ideas. It offers AI chat conversations, image generation, voice interactions, document analysis, and personalized recommendations.

verdict.one_liner: Microsoft's AI assistant collects extensive data for personalization and service improvement, with opt-outs available for AI training and personalized ads.
verdict.summary: Microsoft Copilot is a feature-rich AI assistant that requires a Microsoft account and collects substantial personal data including conversations, location, device information, and usage patterns. While the company provides strong data protection measures, transparent privacy controls, and options to opt out of AI training and targeted advertising, the breadth of data collection and sharing with third-party advertising partners warrants caution. Children's data receives enhanced protections under COPPA/GDPR-K.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Extensive data collection for AI training and advertising purposes, though opt-out options are available. Best suited for users already in the Microsoft ecosystem who are comfortable with data sharing.

red.title: Conversations may train AI models
red.plain_english: In certain markets, Microsoft uses your Copilot conversations to train its AI models unless you manually opt out. This means things you say to the AI could help improve the model for everyone.

red.title: Data shared for personalized ads
red.plain_english: Microsoft shares your personal data (name, contact info, demographics, usage patterns) with third-party advertising platforms like Facebook, Yahoo, and The Trade Desk to show you targeted ads.

red.title: Extensive personal data collection
red.plain_english: Microsoft collects a wide range of personal data including your conversations, voice data, location, device info, browsing history, contacts, and content you upload. This data is used across Microsoft services.

red.title: Conversation history used for personalization
red.plain_english: In some markets, Microsoft uses your prior Copilot conversation history to personalize responses based on your interests and goals, unless you opt out.

green.title: Comprehensive privacy controls
green.plain_english: Microsoft provides a privacy dashboard where you can access, delete, and export your personal data. You can also opt out of personalized advertising and AI training.

green.title: Conversations not used for ad targeting
green.plain_english: Microsoft explicitly states they do not use what you say in Copilot chats, emails, or documents to target ads to you.

green.title: Strong children's privacy protections
green.plain_english: For users under 13, Microsoft requires parental consent and provides enhanced protections including data minimization and restrictions on advertising.

green.title: Data deletion and export rights
green.plain_english: You can request deletion of your personal data and export your conversations and files. Microsoft provides tools to manage your data through the privacy dashboard.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Copilot can access your camera and microphone for features like voice chat and image analysis, but only when you actively use these features.
categories.detail: The app requests camera access for Copilot Vision (image analysis) and microphone access for voice chat features. These permissions are optional and only activated when you explicitly use these features.
categories.policy_excerpt: Certain Copilot features require access to your device capabilities, such as your device camera, microphone, photos, and videos.
concerns: Voice data may be collected during voice interactions
Camera access for Vision feature

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Copilot uses your location to provide relevant local results (like nearby restaurants), but you can disable this in settings.
categories.detail: Location data is used to personalize responses, such as finding nearby restaurants or weather. Location can be inferred from GPS, IP address, or account profile. Users can manage location settings in the app.
categories.policy_excerpt: To provide a relevant response, Microsoft Copilot will use this prompt, along with your location, language, and similar settings...
concerns: Location used for personalization and recommendations
IP address used for location inference

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you choose to share content from Copilot, the app may access your contacts, but this is optional and only for sharing features.
categories.detail: Contacts access is not required for core Copilot functionality. It may be requested if you choose to share Copilot-generated content with others from your address book.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data about your contacts and relationships if you use a product to share information with others...
concerns: Contact data may be accessed for sharing features

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: You can upload files, images, and documents to Copilot for analysis, but the app doesn't continuously scan your files.
categories.detail: Users can voluntarily upload files, images, and documents to Copilot for AI analysis and processing. This is user-initiated and not automatic file scanning.
categories.policy_excerpt: ...other data you might input into the service (for example, files, images, and visual media) to formulate a helpful response.
concerns: Uploaded content is processed on Microsoft servers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Microsoft shares your data with advertising partners, service providers, and analytics companies. You can opt out of personalized ad sharing.
categories.detail: Microsoft shares personal data with third-party advertising platforms (Facebook, Yahoo, The Trade Desk, Xandr), analytics providers, and service providers. While opt-outs exist for personalized advertising, some data sharing continues for operational purposes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may 'share' your personal data, as defined under California and other applicable U.S. state laws, for personalized advertising purposes...
concerns: Data shared with multiple advertising partners
Opt-out required to limit sharing
Cross-site tracking via partners

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need a Microsoft account to use Copilot, which stores your name, email, and profile information.
categories.detail: A Microsoft account is required to use Copilot. The account stores credentials, name and contact data, payment data, device and usage data, interests, favorites, and activity data. This data is used across Microsoft products for personalization.
categories.policy_excerpt: With a Microsoft account, you can sign in to Microsoft products... Personal data associated with your Microsoft account includes credentials, name and contact data, payment data...
concerns: Microsoft account required for full functionality
Data combined across Microsoft services

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Microsoft tracks your app usage, interests, and online activity to show you targeted ads. You can opt out of this tracking.
categories.detail: Microsoft collects interaction data, interests, favorites, browsing history, and content consumption data to deliver personalized advertising. This data is combined across Microsoft products and shared with advertising partners. Opt-out is available through privacy settings.
categories.policy_excerpt: Microsoft uses cookies to collect data about your online activity and identify your interests so that we can provide advertising that is most relevant to you.
concerns: Extensive behavioral tracking
Cross-service profiling
Data combined with third-party sources

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Microsoft has strong protections for children under 13, requiring parental consent and limiting data collection and advertising.
categories.detail: For users under 13, Microsoft requires parental consent, does not collect more data than needed, does not sell or rent child data, and does not use child data for advertising. Parents can manage child accounts through Microsoft Family Safety.
categories.policy_excerpt: For users under the age of 13... certain Microsoft products and services will either block users under that age or will ask them to obtain consent or authorization from a parent or guardian...

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Copilot requires internet access to work, and Microsoft logs IP addresses and network activity for security and service delivery.
categories.detail: Network activity is logged for security, service delivery, and troubleshooting. IP addresses are collected and may be used for location inference. This is standard for cloud-based AI services.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data about your device and the product and features you use, including... IP address, device identifiers...
concerns: IP address used for approximate location

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Microsoft collects detailed device information including unique identifiers, which are used for advertising and analytics.
categories.detail: Extensive device data is collected including device identifiers (IMEI, advertising ID), hardware and software info, configuration data, and nearby networks. This data is used for advertising targeting, personalization, and service improvement.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data about your device, your device configuration, and nearby networks. For example, data about the operating systems and other software installed on your device... IP address, device identifiers...
concerns: Device ID used for ad targeting
Extensive device fingerprinting
Data combined with usage patterns

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Copilot does not collect health or biometric data. Any Face ID usage is handled locally by your device.
categories.detail: The app does not collect health or biometric data. Biometric authentication (Face ID/Touch ID) is handled locally by the device's operating system and not stored by Microsoft.
categories.policy_excerpt: Biometric data and identifiers... Our collection and use of biometric data depends on the products and features you use...

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: If you make purchases through Microsoft, payment data is processed. Microsoft 365 Copilot requires a subscription.
categories.detail: Payment data is collected when you make purchases. For Microsoft 365 Copilot features, a subscription is required. Payment processing follows standard Microsoft payment practices.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment data. Data to process payments, such as your payment instrument number...
concerns: Subscription required for premium features

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your Copilot conversation history and request deletion of your account data, though some data may be retained for legal or operational reasons.
categories.detail: Users can access, update, and delete personal data through the Microsoft privacy dashboard. Conversation history can be managed in-app. Some data may be retained for legal compliance, security, or operational needs. Account closure has a 60-day waiting period.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can request access to, erasure of, and updates to your personal data... We also retain personal data for other legitimate purposes such as operating our business, meeting our contractual and legal obligations...
concerns: Some data retention required by law
60-day waiting period for account deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Microsoft notifies users of material privacy policy changes by posting notices or sending direct notifications.
categories.detail: Microsoft updates the 'last updated' date when changes are made. For material changes, they notify users by prominently posting notices or direct notification. Users are encouraged to periodically review the privacy statement.
categories.policy_excerpt: When we post changes to this statement, we will revise the 'last updated' date... If there are material changes... we will notify you either by prominently posting a notice... or by directly sending you a notification.
concerns: Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance
